استأيكوا (form X)
# اِسْتَأْيَكُوا (istaʔyakū) /is.taʔ.ja.kuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَأْيَكَ (istaʔyaka)
# اِسْتَأْيِكُوا (istaʔyikū) /is.taʔ.ji.kuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَأْيَكَ (istaʔyaka)
